changelog: YouTube playlists were reading as empty, and had been for some time. Asking the server for a real playlist answered nothing at all - no error, no warning in the log, just a playlist with no videos in it - and the same thing happened whenever a week was laid out with a playlist as one of its sources, which is the part that mattered. The cause is at YouTube's end: the entries in a playlist page used to arrive as one kind of object and now arrive as another, and the reader was still looking for the old one. It reads both now, taking the video, its title and its length from wherever they are, and it skips the things on a playlist page that are not videos rather than trying to schedule a channel as a programme. Three tests hold the new shape, written from a real answer rather than an imagined one. This was found by adding a playlist through the page that 1.0.73.0 built - the page reports an empty playlist out loud now, which is the only reason anybody noticed.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
